title: compressed-ai-tutors: fidelity, confident error and inference energy under LLM compression
description:
Code and results for a study measuring answer fidelity, confident error, semantic entropy and measured inference energy across three open-weight model families at three quantisation levels. 2,922 fixed items across a school-to-expert difficulty gradient, 53,298 inferences on a single CPU. Accuracy changed by at most 2.8 percentage points and never significantly, while 5.7 to 20.3 per cent of individual answers changed at 4-bit. None of the eighteen compressed configurations satisfied a deployability rule fixed before any model ran.

No benchmark item text is redistributed; the item manifest carries identifiers only.
